snippet.title: DANJIGOKU - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
DANJIGOKU is a retro-styled classic arcade twin-stick shoot 'em up game. Shoot through hordes of aliens and collect 7 different kinds of upgrades to survive as long as possible!

Published by Xeneder Team
Also released on PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #xenederteam #theforeseenarcade #danjigoku
